slides.title: Glad you're here
slides.body: I'll walk you around once. Skip anytime.

cues.say: Glad you're here.
I'll walk you around Site Plumb once. The daily habit. Your book of houses. And where the desk work lives.
Skip whenever you like. Nothing here can break.

slides.title: Field Notes
slides.body: House, photo, chip, Send. Same camera everywhere.

cues.say: See this camera? That's Field Notes.
Out on a job you pick the house, take a picture, tap a chip, and hit Send.
You can file the trade later, sitting at a desk. Same camera, everywhere you work.
Now you. Tap the camera.
This is your book.
Needs You is what opens first. The hottest work sits on top.
Recent Decisions is the paper trail.
A to Z is just the street names. Three ways to look at the same houses.

slides.title: The houses
slides.body: All homes, then each job. Tap for a briefing.

cues.say: All homes sits at the top. That's every open item, every house.
Each row under it is one job. Tap a house and you get a briefing. You don't have to open the whole site.

slides.title: The briefing
slides.body: One house. What still needs you, then the doors.

cues.say: This is the briefing. Just this house.
What still needs you is at the top.
Then the doors. Field Notes, Schedule, Selections, and Money. Most days, this is enough.

slides.title: The doors
slides.body: Schedule, Selections, Money, Field Notes — this house only.

cues.say: These doors stay on this house.
Schedule is the calendar for just this job.
Selections are the finishes.
Money is what they owe.
And Field Notes from here already knows which house you're on.

slides.title: The packet
slides.body: Still open is what the sub sees. Live.

cues.say: See what's still open?
That's what your sub sees in their install packet. File a leak or a punch to a trade at the desk, and it shows up on their phone. Live. No text thread.

slides.title: Full site
slides.body: Log, Needs You, Build, Files. Desk work.

cues.say: Full site is there when you need the whole job.
Log.
Needs You.
Build.
And Files. Same four jobs you already know. Same Field Notes camera. Desk work lives here. You don't have to start here.

slides.title: Company
slides.body: Calendar, invoices, roster, team. The office drawer.

cues.say: And this little briefcase? That's Company.
The trades calendar across every house. Invoices. Your standing roster. The team. Add a job.
It's the office drawer, not a house.
You're set.
Field Notes from the field. The book when you're home. A briefing per house. The packet for the sub.
Full site and Company when you need the desk. Replay any time from Settings. I'll get out of your way.
